fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $39,950, paid in lump sum upon executing the Franchise Agreement, uniformly imposed and non-refundable. In 2025, fee was discounted to $30,000 for some franchisees signing a Multi-Unit Development Agreement and/or acquiring certain stores previously owned by affiliates. A 15% veteran's discount ($5,992.50 off) is available for the first Franchise Agreement executed by an honorably discharged veteran or affiliate, excluding Multi-Unit Development Agreement units. Multi-unit development fees are separate: $99,875 for 3 stores, $119,850 for 4 stores, $139,825 for 5 stores.
raw_excerpt: Initial Franchise Fee : You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $3 9,950 upon executing the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is payable in a lump sum, fully earned upon your execution of the Franchise Agreement, uniformly imposed, and is not refundable under any circumstances. However, in 2025, we discounted the initial franchise fee to $ 30,000 for some franchisees who signed a Multi-Unit Development Agreement and/or acquired certain everbowl Stores that were previously owned by our affiliates.
